name: Local SEO Lesson - Getting Only 5 Star Reviews
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Tactics for collecting 5-star Google reviews.

# What the lesson recommends
- Ask friends for 5-star reviews with comments that include the target keyword and a local detail.
- Always ask happy customers for a review.
- A "review funnel": a landing page asks for a 1 to 5 rating first; 4 to 5 stars go to Google, 3 or less go to a private contact form.
- Offering a small reward (about $10) for a 5-star review.

# TAG caution
TAG caution: this lesson includes tactics that violate Google Business Profile or review policies. They can get a listing suspended and are not used on TAG clients. Google prohibits reviews from friends posing as customers, incentivized reviews and selectively soliciting positive reviews (review gating). The FTC also treats fake and incentivized reviews as deceptive.

# Safe version to keep
- Ask every customer, at the moment of a good experience, with a direct review link.
- Never filter who receives the link and never offer anything for a review.
- Respond to every review, including negative ones (see [Local SEO Lesson - Module 10 Online Reviews and Reputation Management](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson-module-10-online-reviews-and-reputation-management)).
